name: discovery-fixture
title: Discovery Conformance Fixture Package
description: Provides field and type definitions for the ext:discovery conformance fixture (RFC-012). Four types span the full RFC-032 fieldType classification the RFC-032 Rev-7 erratum settles for I-120: article (searchable — plain and markdown text, URI, closed single- and list-select, open list; excluded — number, integer, boolean, date, date-time, uuid, email, map, ref in both modes, dependent), project and metric (the original legacy-classification spread), and byline (the inline composite range of article.byline). All Field declarations carry RFC-032 `fieldType`; the pre-RFC-032 `valueType` scalar was migrated by the #242 Phase-B cutover (the-greenman/srs#286).
